title: Decide the crate layout for the michi binary
body: Workspace of michi (bin) and libmichi (lib), michi (lib, unchanged) and michi-cli (bin named michi), or a feature-gated bin in the one crate. The library is already published on crates.io as michi, so renaming it breaks dependants.
close_reason: Workspace, library name unchanged, binary crate under a placeholder name

notes.author: Jack Roddy/a556920e
notes.text: Decided: a cargo workspace. The library keeps the name michi, unchanged. The binary crate gets a placeholder name, michi-cli, until Jack names it; the final name will not be michi-cli.
